verdict.rationale: Ollama's own documented choice between local and cloud execution lets a user keep data on their own machine ("Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine") or send it to Ollama's Cloud. That is a coarse, first-party form of data-location control. There is no evidence of selecting a region or residency for cloud data. missing for 10: cloud region/residency selection, documented data-storage location policy for Ollama Cloud, independent corroboration of residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
